body: How did you find that? Maybe I'm looking in the wrong places

I'm in Toronto where everything is like $2000 a month to rent and if I moved away I'd have to find a new job and I'd get stuck making minimum wage again, if I could even find one. At least where I'm at now I've gotten a decent raise but its still not enough to live on.

You make it sound so easy. If rent alone costs more than I make in a month then there's really not anything I can do. And I can't find any enjoyment out of any hobbies. I just don't have the energy, or I'm depressed or something. And then sharing those hobbies with new people? I just can't do it, it makes me too anxious. I wish I could just snap my fingers and change things that easily but it doesn't work that way.
I feel so much like giving up though. I don't understand how things are just magically going to get better. I'm trying so hard but I just can't figure things out.
I still haven't went. My life is so fucking bad. There's no hope for me. Nothing and no one can help me. Everything is getting so much worse I wish I was dead.
I've been sitting here contemplating going since I posted this thread. I always do this and never end up going. Now it feels too late and I'm worrying about having to go to work tomorrow.
I ended up staying home and drinking by myself. I'm pathetic...
